name: Guaymallén
shape: geoBoundaries, the department it is named for

climate: A dry climate, and what little rain there is falls mostly in summer. Water is scarce.

blurb.text: A wine area in Mendoza, the province that makes nearly two-thirds of Argentina's wine. Malbec leads plantings at 25%, followed by Syrah (11%) and Bonarda (10%).
